paragraphs: Rabbi Hillel son of Rabbi Valas (in Rabbi’s time): [Gittin 59a](https://www.sefaria.org/Gittin.59a.3-4). [Rashi on Sanhedrin 36a](https://www.sefaria.org/Rashi_on_Sanhedrin.36a.7.1) writes “son of Rabbi Valas.” [Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1062&lang=en) understands this to rule out Valus, given as a gentile name in [Gittin 11b](https://www.sefaria.org/Gittin.11b.1-2).[^1]

notes.text: The two supplied forms are וולס, Valas, and ולוס, Valus. The William Davidson digital Gittin 59a gives Rabbi Hillel son of Rabbi Valas; Gittin 11b lists Valus among the non-Jewish names. The distinction between the supplied forms is preserved without inferring a printed-letter history.
